payload.entry: POLICY_COPY API for classifier: RelationsConfig now exposes successor_labels, label_effect, and label_for_inverse; close_effect and close_label_for_inverse remain Cancel/Complete-only. The shared module exports RelationTarget, RelationEvent (Parked/Done plus optional slot), structured RelationHeldReason/RelationHeldRow, and typed copy inputs/builders from task_complete::relation_successors::copy. Tests load config, key, and all copy vectors through the production APIs in relation_successor_vectors.rs.

Implemented successor label policy and typed copy builders; config/key/copy vectors pass (including overlap warning bytes and Unicode truncation), and cancel, complete, inverse, formatting, and lint checks pass. epic-symbols reports no leftovers.

payload.entry: FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE before repair tale: reviewed every note on phases .1/.2/.3 and used sase_new_task (all-status semantic search, last-week task sweep, active-epic review). .1 #1 SU-P22 and .1 #2 SA23 are one shared-fixture parity issue caused by this epic, not separate tasks. Cycler copy is now byte-identical (SHA256 08ffccedd68489dbfc06c73faf7a1be65df7b49cb48fdee1804f98d748c11cc0); navigation copy still differs in exactly those two vectors. Its relationCopyTruncate also returns 49 code points and splits an emoji. Repair and focused parity/Unicode tests belong to the landing tale; recorded on outer bob-cli-fs. .3 #1 human_pick_suffix_and_not_pulled_in is declined as already resolved: b483c93b updates the stale ^write-changelog expectation, and cargo test --test cli capture::keep_moving::human_pick_suffix_and_not_pulled_in -- --exact passes on cb729a76 (1/1). No genuinely distinct external follow-up remains and no new task was created. Copy this triage disposition into the eventual close note.

LAND AUDIT at cb729a76 (fresh origin/master matches): reviewed epic/three closed phases/all notes, approved core and parent plans, DECISIONS, c3a2e62a/ace86f8e/cb729a76 source changes, and intervening 311b1514/b483c93b/fa1118c1 (also nearby 16f3a28f/a8f61375). Capture stays relation: None; no core memory/version/changelog edits. Four temporary Rust probes fail: classifier same-note ordering uses IDs (a-second before z-first), planner numbers Ready before Next across notes, a genuinely Blocked recovered dependent loses relation metadata, and an id-less duplicate-text offer changes the wrong task. Probe source file:explicit:02f513efcf6d714094b172c0 and result file:explicit:ed01e90996e17bd9acfc75b6; tracked source restored byte-for-byte. Additional concrete source gaps: explicit RelationEvent.slot is never read; integrated resolver ignores the full NoteIndex and cannot safely represent resolved unavailable targets; raw dependency counts/effective recovery and display-vs-placement dedup need correction; integration coverage skips fixture expectations and capture compatibility merely repeats one identical planner invocation. No epic-symbol entries for this epic or parent phase; no symvision recipe. These are residual epic work, not task follow-ups. Authored medium tale sase_plan_relation_successor_core_closeout.md with regression-backed repairs, navigation fixture integration, just check/docs-check, and same-turn epic plus bob-cli-fs.2 phase closeout. Epic remains open pending that work.

DISCOVERED ISSUE corroboration from bob-cli-fs.8.1 landing, proposed by bob-cli-fs.8.1.4 note #3: bob-plugins 2ead3a8 still has navigation relation_successor vectors SHA256 22ad9ac75a0daa4bb13711b60cd1dbd7547aa9e47ab80cf09ffd4c924143fd4f versus canonical/cycler 08ffccedd68489dbfc06c73faf7a1be65df7b49cb48fdee1804f98d748c11cc0. This matches your notes #1/#2 and existing repair tale ownership for SA23/SU-P22 plus Unicode truncation. No duplicate task and no competing navigation edits from this landing.

Closeout partial implementation: 4 land-audit probes now permanent and passing (classifier_orders_same_lane_by_source_line, planner_numbers_next_before_ready_across_notes, recovered_blocked_direct_dependent_keeps_relation_reason, missing_id_selects_the_exact_source_row). Classifier now orders rows by source line and groups by target path+line; planner OfferOrderKey is now (group, target-order|anchor, lane, path, line) with relation group_order so Next precedes Ready and placement never orders relation groups; identity uses line-based keys (no text resolve, no bare-path collision) and recovered ? offers as Ready; integrate uses full NoteIndex for known paths. Plugin parity: nav vectors copied byte-identical (08ffcced...), 206b truncate fixed to 48-scalar Array.from (matches Rust/cycler, astral-safe), nav/cycler vector+presentation suites pass (22+69), build and build:check pass. Deploy refused safely: bob plugins sync would overwrite uncommitted builds from bob-cli_10 (block-id-prompt) and bob-cli_16 (nav-hotkeys); did not force with -F. Residual per plan still open: explicit RelationEvent.slot production read with line-coordinate validation/fallback, effective-state projection for raw depends_on/project hide-tag (beyond recovered ?), relation-winner placement rebuild + fold recompute + keep-moving fold filtering, full SA14/SA15/SA18/SA20/SA21 coverage without skip-counting, run_planner keep-moving/bob_dir typed-routing proof, and real temp-vault capture compat across 3 configs. Beads left open; just check/docs-check not yet run to green.
